meta.description: Case studies: medical practices, political campaigns, technical businesses. Every site scores 90+ on Google's performance test.

work.intro1: I build for businesses where trust decides everything — medical practices, political campaigns, technical companies. Different industries, same job: give people enough confidence to pick up the phone.
work.intro2: Every site scores over 90 on Google's performance test. For comparison: typical Localsearch or Wix pages land at 40–60. Faster pages rank better — and lose fewer visitors.

schlafzahnmedizin.lead: A specialty deserves more than a subpage.
body: Dr. Neumann treats sleep apnea — a service that would have disappeared on a normal practice website. Instead of burying it there, we gave it its own home: a focused site that positions Dr. Neumann as the regional specialist and attracts patients specifically looking for this.
From symptom to therapy to professional societies: the page builds trust step by step — and brings new patients back to the practice.
This isn't a website. It's patient acquisition with its own address.
schlafzahnmedizin.assetTodo: public/images/work/schlafzahnmedizin.webp — flattering section screenshot from schlafzahnmedizin.ch

wicki.lead: When the Stadtpräsident calls, there is no second chance.
body: A campaign website has a fixed deadline, zero tolerance for failure, and exactly one job: turn visitors into supporters. For André Wicki's re-election as Stadtpräsident of Zug, we built a site that communicates results and goals clearly — built fast, loads fast, reliable through election day.
Politics is the hardest trust industry there is. That's exactly why this project is here.
wicki.assetTodo: public/images/work/wicki.webp — flattering section screenshot from wickizug.ch

pietrobon.h3: Pietrobon & Michel — Dental lab on Bahnhofstrasse
body: A dental lab on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse with an international clientele needs a website that matches the location. The site is in four languages — German, English, Italian, Russian — and reflects the lab's standard: highest craftsmanship, presented discreetly.
pietrobon.assetTodo: public/images/work/pietrobon.webp — flattering section screenshot from pietrobonundmichel.ch

obrenovic.lead: The website should feel like the practice: calm, careful, trustworthy.
body: For a dental practice on Lake Zürich, flash doesn't matter — the feeling does: I'm in good hands here. Clear structure, pleasant design, a direct path to booking — that's all it takes, and that's the craft.
obrenovic.assetTodo: public/images/work/obrenovic.webp — flattering section screenshot from drobrenovic.ch

neumann.lead: The practice site as foundation — fast, clear, findable.
body: The practice's main presence: treatments, team, appointment booking. Solidly built with a perfect Google Performance Score of 100 — the technical base for the two-site strategy with schlafzahnmedizin.ch.
neumann.meta: Part of a two-site strategy → Schlafzahnmedizin
